generateName.description: When true the server derives name from spec.display.name plus a random suffix. Requires an empty name and a non-empty spec.display.name.

image.description: Icon or logo shown in the dashboard list: the path of an icon or logo bundled with the UI under /assets/Icons/ or /assets/Logos/ (only the prefix is validated), or a base64 image data URI for png, jpeg, gif, webp, avif or svg. Empty for none.

name.description: The dashboard's unique name, a DNS-1123 label (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters). Immutable after creation. Must be empty when generateName is true.

schemaVersion.description: The dashboard schema version. Must be v6.

spec.description: The dashboard content: display, variables, panels, layouts and links.

tags.description: Up to 10 key/value tags, for example key team with value payments. Keys must not be one of the reserved list filter keys: name, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by, locked, source. Use [] for none.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

aggregations.description: The aggregations to compute, one result per entry. Traces and logs take expressions such as count() or p99(duration_nano); metrics take a metricName with time and space aggregations. Omit for raw requests.

bucketOptions.description: The value axis to count this query into, as a kind-discriminated linear or log bucket spec. Read only by heatmap requests, and only from the query they draw.

cursor.description: The opaque nextCursor value from a previous raw result, used to fetch the next page.

disabled.description: When true, the result is excluded from the response; the query may still run and can still feed a formula or trace operator. Defaults to false.

filter.description: The filter that selects spans, in the query filter syntax, for example service.name = 'frontend' AND http.response.status_code >= 500.

functions.description: Post-processing functions applied in order to each result series, such as absolute, cumulativeSum, timeShift or anomaly.

groupBy.description: The fields to group aggregations by; each group becomes a series or a row with the field as a label or column.

having.description: A filter applied to aggregation results, referencing aliases or expressions, for example count() > 100.

legend.description: The display name template for each series; {{field}} placeholders are replaced by group-by label values.

limit.description: The maximum number of rows for raw requests, or of series or rows for grouped aggregations, keeping the top entries by order. When 0, aggregations are unlimited while raw requests ordered by timestamp return a page of 10000 rows; follow nextCursor for the rest.

limitBy.description: Reserved for applying limit within each combination of the given group-by keys. Accepted but currently ignored.

name.description: The unique name of the query, such as A or B; formulas, trace operators and selectedQueryName refer to it.

offset.description: The number of rows to skip before returning results. Prefer cursor for raw requests.

order.description: The sort order of the result. Order by a group-by field, an aggregation alias, or for raw requests a selected field such as timestamp.

secondaryAggregations.description: Accepted but currently ignored, including their nested order, limit and limitBy.

selectFields.description: The fields to return for each row in raw requests, in addition to the columns always present: timestamp and id for logs, timestamp, trace_id and span_id for traces. Ignored by aggregating requests.

signal.description: The telemetry signal to query: traces, logs or metrics. It selects the aggregation shape and is required for builder_query.

source.description: The data source within the signal. Set to meter for Cost Meter metrics; leave empty for regular telemetry.

stepInterval.description: The time bucket for time_series aggregation: seconds as a number or a Go duration string such as 60s or 1m. Derived from the time range when omitted.

fillMode.description: The fill under each line: solid (default) or gradient.

fillOpacity.description: The fill opacity from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque). Null uses the chart default.

lineInterpolation.description: How points are joined: linear, spline (default), step_after or step_before.

lineStyle.description: The line stroke: solid (default) or dashed.

showPoints.description: Whether each data point is marked on the line.

spanGaps.description: Whether lines connect across missing points.

formatting.description: Unit and decimal precision of the values.

thresholds.description: Horizontal reference lines drawn at fixed values.

visualization.description: Time range, gap handling and stacking.

fillSpans.description: Whether intervals with no data are drawn as zero instead of a gap.

stack.description: How the areas combine: none (default) overlays them, normal stacks the values, percent stacks them as shares of the total.

timePreference.description: The time range the panel queries: global_time (default) follows the dashboard range; last_5_min, last_15_min, last_30_min, last_1_hr, last_6_hr, last_1_day, last_3_days, last_1_week or last_1_month pin a fixed window.

isLogScale.description: Whether the Y axis uses a logarithmic scale.

softMax.description: The highest value the Y axis always shows; data above it still extends the axis. Null fits the data.

softMin.description: The lowest value the Y axis always shows; data below it still extends the axis. Null fits the data.

stackedBarChart.description: Whether the series are stacked on top of each other.

color.description: The CSS color applied to the text or background, per format, while the threshold is active. For example #F1575F matches the SigNoz red preset; CSS named colors such as red also work.

format.description: What the color is applied to: text (default) or background.

operator.description: The comparison that activates the threshold: above (default), below, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, equal or not_equal.

value.description: The value compared against, in unit.

customValue.description: The fixed values as a comma-separated list, such as 1,10,100.

duration.description: The default time range, as a Prometheus duration such as 1h or 7d. Stored, but not applied by the UI.

layouts.description: The Grid layouts that place panels, at most 500. Each panel can be placed at most once. Use [] for none.

links.description: External links stored with the dashboard. Not shown by the UI.

panels.description: The panels keyed by panel id. An id has up to 75 characters from letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen. A panel is shown only where a layout item references it as #/spec/panels/<id>. Use {} for none.

refreshInterval.description: The auto refresh interval, as a Prometheus duration such as 30s. Stored, but not applied by the UI.

variables.description: The dashboard variables, each a ListVariable or TextVariable envelope, referenced in queries as $name. Names must be unique. Use [] for none.

name.description: The human-readable title, at most 128 characters.

colors.description: The color scale applied to bucket counts.

palette.description: The named color ramp used in palette mode, such as lava (default), ice or ember.

steps.description: The number of distinct color steps, 2 to 128. 0 uses the chart default.

chartAppearance.description: How bucket counts map to colors.

visualization.description: The time range the heatmap covers.

bucketWidth.description: The width of each bucket in the value unit. A positive value takes precedence over bucketCount; null or 0 lets the chart choose.

mergeAllActiveQueries.description: Whether every series is combined into a single histogram instead of one per series.

histogramBuckets.description: How values are grouped into buckets.

spec.description: The grid section: an optional display title and up to 100 items that place panels. renderVariables.description: Whether dashboard variable values are substituted into url before opening it.

targetBlank.description: Whether the link opens in a new tab.

tooltip.description: Hover text for the link. Stored, but not shown by the UI.

url.description: The link target. May reference dashboard variables as {{name}} when renderVariables is true.

capturingRegexp.description: A regular expression meant to keep only matching values, reduced to the capture group when one is present. Stored, but not applied by the UI.

customAllValue.description: The value meant to replace every value when all is selected. Requires allowAllValue. Stored, but currently ignored by the UI.

defaultValue.description: The initially selected value: a string, or a list of strings when allowMultiple is true.

fillLessThan.description: The largest gap still connected when fillOnlyBelow is true; longer gaps are left disconnected. Required in that case, as a positive Prometheus duration such as 30s, 5m or 1d.

fillOnlyBelow.description: Controls whether lines connect across null values. When false (default), all gaps are connected. When true, only gaps smaller than fillLessThan are connected.

columnUnits.description: Unit id per value column, keyed by the column key: the query name for a builder query with one aggregation (A), the query name dotted with the aggregation expression for several (A.count()), or the SQL alias for a ClickHouse SQL column. queries.description: The queries to run, each wrapped in a type-discriminated envelope. Names must be unique; formulas and trace operators reference other queries by name.

expression.description: A filter in the query filter syntax: comparisons such as =, !=, <, >, IN, LIKE, CONTAINS and EXISTS on field names, combined with AND, OR and NOT, with string values in single quotes, for example key = 'value' AND other_key > 10. Which fields exist depends on the signal or endpoint the filter is used with.

args.description: The function arguments; which ones are required depends on the function, for example a threshold for the cutOff and clamp functions.

name.description: The function to apply, such as cutOffMin, cutOffMax, clampMin, clampMax, absolute, runningDiff, log2, log10, cumulativeSum, ewma3, ewma5, ewma7, median3, median5, median7, timeShift, anomaly or fillZero.

value.description: The argument value as a number, string or boolean, for example the threshold for cutOffMin or the duration for timeShift.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the field, present only for well-known fields.

fieldContext.description: Where the field lives: resource, attribute, scope, span, trace, log, body or metric. Empty means unspecified, so the server resolves it.

fieldDataType.description: Data type of the field values: string, bool, int64, float64 or number. Empty means unspecified.

name.description: The field name, such as service.name, k8s.pod.name or http.response.status_code. Dots are part of the name, and the names available depend on the signal and the data ingested.

signal.description: The signal the field belongs to: traces, logs or metrics. Empty means any signal.

unit.description: Unit of the field values, present only for well-known fields.

expression.description: A condition on aggregation results in the filter syntax, referencing an alias or expression, for example count() > 100.

keys.description: The group-by field names that partition the result before the limit is applied.

value.description: The aggregation alias or expression whose value ranks entries within each partition.

maxValue.description: The upper bound of the last regular band; values above it are counted in a trailing overflow band.

numBuckets.description: The number of evenly spaced bands between 0 and maxValue. A default applies when omitted or 0.

alias.description: The name the aggregation is reported under; when omitted, the result carries the alias __result_N, with N the zero-based index of the aggregation.

expression.description: The aggregation over log records, such as count(), sum(item_price), count_distinct(user_id) or countIf(day > 10).

scale.description: The exponential histogram scale: 2^scale bands per doubling of the value. The maximum supported scale applies when omitted.

comparisonSpaceAggregationParam.description: Histogram metrics with spaceAggregation count only: the comparison operator and bucket bound used to estimate how many observations fall at or below, or above, the threshold. Ignored for other metric types and aggregations.

metricName.description: The name of the metric to query, for example k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization.

reduceTo.description: How a series collapses to one number in scalar requests: sum, count, avg, min, max, last or median. Ignored by time_series requests.

spaceAggregation.description: How series are combined across each group, such as sum, avg, min, max or count; histograms take percentiles such as p50, p90, p95 or p99.

temporality.description: The temporality of the metric: delta, cumulative or unspecified. Resolved from the metric metadata when omitted.

timeAggregation.description: How samples of one series are combined within each step, such as avg, sum, min, max, count, count_distinct, latest, rate or increase.

direction.description: The sort direction: asc or desc.

key.description: The sort key. bucketOptions.description: The value axis to count this query into, as a kind-discriminated linear or log bucket spec. Read only by heatmap requests, and only from the query they draw.

cursor.description: The opaque nextCursor value from a previous raw result, used to fetch the next page.

disabled.description: When true, the result is excluded from the response; the query may still run and can still feed a formula or trace operator. Defaults to false.

filter.description: The filter that selects spans, in the query filter syntax, for example service.name = 'frontend' AND http.response.status_code >= 500.

functions.description: Post-processing functions applied in order to each result series, such as absolute, cumulativeSum, timeShift or anomaly.

groupBy.description: The fields to group aggregations by; each group becomes a series or a row with the field as a label or column.

having.description: A filter applied to aggregation results, referencing aliases or expressions, for example count() > 100.

legend.description: The display name template for each series; {{field}} placeholders are replaced by group-by label values.

limit.description: The maximum number of rows for raw requests, or of series or rows for grouped aggregations, keeping the top entries by order. When 0, aggregations are unlimited while raw requests ordered by timestamp return a page of 10000 rows; follow nextCursor for the rest.

limitBy.description: Reserved for applying limit within each combination of the given group-by keys. Accepted but currently ignored.

name.description: The unique name of the query, such as A or B; formulas, trace operators and selectedQueryName refer to it.

offset.description: The number of rows to skip before returning results. Prefer cursor for raw requests.

order.description: The sort order of the result. Order by a group-by field, an aggregation alias, or for raw requests a selected field such as timestamp.

secondaryAggregations.description: Accepted but currently ignored, including their nested order, limit and limitBy.

selectFields.description: The fields to return for each row in raw requests, in addition to the columns always present: timestamp and id for logs, timestamp, trace_id and span_id for traces. Ignored by aggregating requests.

source.description: The data source within the signal. Set to meter for Cost Meter metrics; leave empty for regular telemetry.

stepInterval.description: The time bucket for time_series aggregation: seconds as a number or a Go duration string such as 60s or 1m. Derived from the time range when omitted.

aggregations.description: The aggregations to compute over the matched traces for scalar and time_series requests.

cursor.description: Accepted but currently ignored by the trace operator; page raw results with offset.

disabled.description: When true, the result is excluded from the response but the query may still run. Defaults to false.

expression.description: A trace-structure expression over traces builder query names using => for direct child, -> for descendant, && for both present, || for either present and NOT for absence, for example A => B && NOT C. At most 10 operators.

filter.description: Accepted but currently not applied to the matched traces. Put filters on the operand queries instead.

functions.description: Post-processing functions applied in order to each result series.

groupBy.description: The fields to group aggregations by.

having.description: A condition on the aggregation results, for example count() > 10.

legend.description: The display name template for each series; {{field}} placeholders are replaced by group-by label values.

limit.description: The maximum number of traces or groups to return. For raw requests 0 means 100 rows; for aggregations 0 means unlimited.

name.description: The unique name of the trace operator query.

offset.description: The number of raw results to skip before returning. Aggregation requests ignore it.

order.description: The sort order of the matched traces; only span_count and trace_duration may be used as keys.

returnSpansFrom.description: The name of the operand query whose spans are returned; when empty, the spans matched by the whole expression are returned.

selectFields.description: The span fields to return for each row in raw requests, in addition to the always-present timestamp, trace_id and span_id columns.

stepInterval.description: The time bucket for time_series aggregation: seconds as a number or a Go duration string such as 60s.

alias.description: The name the aggregation is reported under; when omitted, the result carries the alias __result_N, with N the zero-based index of the aggregation.

expression.description: The aggregation over the primary results, such as count(), sum(item_price) or countIf(day > 10).

groupBy.description: The fields to group this aggregation by.

limit.description: The maximum number of groups to return. Unlimited when 0.

limitBy.description: Applies limit within each distinct combination of the given keys.

order.description: The sort order of this aggregation result.

stepInterval.description: The time bucket for this aggregation: seconds as a number or a Go duration string. Uses the primary aggregation step when omitted.

Querybuildertypesv5Step.description: Step interval. Accepts a Go duration string (e.g., "60s", "1m", "1h") or a number representing seconds (e.g., 60).

alias.description: The name the aggregation is reported under; when omitted, the result carries the alias __result_N, with N the zero-based index of the aggregation.

expression.description: The aggregation over spans, such as count(), sum(item_price), p99(duration_nano) or countIf(day > 10).

description.description: Human-readable summary of the field, present only for well-known fields.

fieldContext.description: Where the field lives: resource, attribute, scope, span, trace, log, body or metric. Empty means unspecified, so the server resolves it.

fieldDataType.description: Data type of the field values: string, bool, int64, float64 or number. Empty means unspecified.

name.description: The field name, such as service.name, k8s.pod.name or http.response.status_code. Dots are part of the name, and the names available depend on the signal and the data ingested.

signal.description: The signal the field belongs to: traces, logs or metrics. Empty means any signal.

unit.description: Unit of the field values, present only for well-known fields.
